chunks: From him, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from 'Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan al-Darir, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Ja'far, from his father, from 'Ali عليه السلام, who said:

It was said to him: Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-Malik enters the bathhouse with his slave-girls. He said: There is no harm in that if waist-wraps are upon him and upon them, such that they are not naked like donkeys, looking at one another's private parts.

key_terms.الْأُزُرُ: waist-wraps or garments used to cover the body
key_terms.الْحَمَّامَ: the bathhouse or public bathing place
key_terms.سَوْأَةِ: the private part or area of nakedness that must be concealed

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to enter the bathhouse with his slave-girls if everyone is properly covered?
ai.summary: This hadith states that entering the bathhouse together is not objectionable so long as proper covering is maintained. Its significance is the emphasis on preserving modesty and avoiding exposure of the private parts, even in shared bathing spaces.
